tidbit: Did you know… about 7,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Google cuts free Gemini access to its weakest model, while users paying 5 dollars monthly lose access to Pro. Reported by The Decoder.
Thales launches artificial intelligence and quantum security tools to combat evolving cyber threats. Reported by DATAQUEST.
Sign in with ChatGPT shares your name and email with only invited sites getting access. Reported by MIXED Reality News.
China-aligned TA419 targets U.S. artificial intelligence policy experts with Microsoft account takeover phishing attacks. Reported by The Hacker News.
Suno launches Speech, a tool that puts music to spoken word content, with industry partnerships and royalty payments included. Reported by The Business Times.
Free every hour.
